test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which water reservoir has been declared a ‘Ramsar site’ on the list of wetlands of international importance in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sur Sarovar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sur Sarovar, **also known as Keetham Lake, was designated as a **Ramsar site in 2020**.
 
• This man-made reservoir, located in **Agra, Uttar Pradesh,** was initially constructed to supply water to the city of Agra during the summer months.
 
• Sur Sarovar has transformed into a vital ecosystem boasting a diverse range of habitats, serving as a sanctuary for both migratory and resident bird species, in addition to hosting over 60 species of fish.
 
• A Ramsar site is a wetland area recognized for its international significance under the Ramsar Convention, an environmental treaty established in 1971 in Ramsar, Iran, and named after the city.
 
• This convention facilitates global collaboration and encourages national efforts toward the conservation and sustainable utilization of wetland resources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Chilika Lake,** situated in the state of Odisha, India, is a vast brackish water lagoon, boasting the title of the largest of its kind in Asia and the second largest coastal lagoon globally, spanning an impressive area of 1,100 square kilometres.
 
• **Pong Dam Lake,** alternatively referred to as Maharana Pratap Sagar, stands as a substantial reservoir located in the Kangra district of Himachal Pradesh, India.
 
• **Sarsai Nawar Jheel,** a permanent marsh, graces the landscape of the Etawah district in Uttar Pradesh.
